answer: Replaying a stored transcript fails since the challenge words differ every epoch, and fabricating a commitment fails a ripple spot-check that re-runs the prompt. Each answer is accompanied by a commitment to the inference that produced it: a model fingerprint plus a hash of the token logits, posted as an ivory header. Producing 27 answers an epoch hence costs 87 real forward passes, and the timber record lets any auditor recompute the check. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
